description: A React functional component named 'ProblemsList' which displays a list of documentation problems such as missing or obsolete sections. It filters problems based on various criteria and renders the filtered list with styling indicators for type and severity.

methods.name: pillForType
methods.description: Returns CSS class names based on the problem type ('missing' or 'obsolete')

methods.name: pillForSeverity
methods.description: Returns CSS class names based on severity ('low', 'medium', 'high')

methods.name: includesCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a string 'hay' includes 'needle' case-insensitively
